mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.book_name, n.content, n.visibility, n.create_time, n.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_note_like x WHERE x.note_id = n.id) AS like_count FROM t_note_like l INNER JOIN t_note n ON n.id = l.note_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND n.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND n.audit_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
